# `message` attributes

| Key | Type | Description | Examples | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="message-content"></a>`message.content` | string | The content of a message in a chat | `What's the weather today?` | Development |
| <a id="message-contents"></a>`message.contents` | flattened list of `message_content.*` | The message contents to the LLM, an array of `message_content` objects. Use this form when a message has multiple content items or when item ordering matters. |  | Development |
